description: Source code for AidlConversionEq class handling audio equalizer parameters via AIDL in Android, including set/get parameter methods and internal logic.

classes.name: AidlConversionEq
classes.description: Class handling conversion of equalizer parameters between internal representation and AIDL interface.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets an equalizer parameter based on EffectParamReader input.

methods.name: getAidlParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a specific AIDL parameter for a given equalizer tag.

methods.name: getParameterPreset
methods.description: Gets the current preset index of the equalizer.

methods.name: getParameterPresetName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the current preset.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Gets various equalizer parameters based on the type specified in EffectParamWriter.
